entry.title: How to get an attractive model. We give a fourth-order Calabi-Yau differential operator, which seems to have been missed by earlier tabulations.
entry.summary:
We give a fourth-order Calabi-Yau differential operator, which seems to have been missed by earlier tabulations. We draw attention to this operator because of its clear geometric interpretation and evidence that it possesses a rank-two attractor, conjecturally giving a new example of a Calabi-Yau threefold with modularity properties analogous to those of an elliptic curve over $\mathbb{Q}$.

Source: arXiv Mathematics (NT, CO, AG, LO, AT, GR) · Tags: #number-theory #combinatorics #high-energy #algebra-geometry

entry.title: Isochronous Fixed-Weight Sampling in Hardware
entry.summary:
We present hardware implementations of the recently proposed isochronous fixed-weight sampling algorithm by Décio Luiz Gazzoni Filho, Tomás S. R. Silva, Julio López (CiC vol. 1, 2024) and apply them to the post-quantum cryptographic algorithms NTRU-HPS, Streamlined NTRU Prime and Classic McEliece.

Source: IACR Cryptology ePrint Archive · Tags: #cryptography #zkp #post-quantum #number-theory
